memory.text: Harbor app launch is planned for September 15, owned by Priya on the mobile team.
Security review found that Harbor stores session tokens in plain local storage. Marked as a launch blocker.
Diego started moving Harbor session tokens to the device keychain. Estimate: two weeks.
Priya asked for weekly launch updates to go to the #harbor-launch channel instead of email.
Harbor launch moved from September 15 to October 6 because the keychain migration will not finish in time.
Marketing rebooked the Harbor launch webinar for October 8 to follow the new date.
Follow-up security review passed after the keychain change was merged. Blocker closed.
Priya is on leave from September 20 to October 3. Sam covers Harbor launch decisions while she is out.
Diego is moving to the payments team after Harbor ships.
Team lunch for the Harbor crew is on Friday at the ramen place near the office.
Harbor release checklist is green except app store screenshots, due September 30.
Sam approved the final app store screenshots for Harbor.

policy.candidateOrder: Frontier ids are sorted ascending; unseen ids beyond maxCandidatesPerRound are dropped for that round and may re-enter later only via links.
policy.scoreNormalization: Jev score answers are on a 0-3 level scale. normalized = score / 3. If score is missing, normalized = expected level from probabilities / 3. Values outside the scale, or probabilities that do not sum to 1 +/- 0.05, are invalid.
policy.rule: Keep a candidate when normalized relevance >= .5 (level 1.5, between background only and partly answers). Stop complete only when validated P(enough) >= .7 and at least one note is kept. One Jev call per round, so the 4-round cap is also the call cap. Round cap, kept-note cap, the 8,000-token per-request input ceiling, graph exhaustion and no seed match stop incomplete with a warning. Any invalid, missing, or timed-out Jev answer stops fail-closed with the evidence so far, marked incomplete.

limits.killSwitch: EVIDENCE_BUDGET_LIVE must equal 1 or live runs return 503 (default off).
limits.clientKey: x-vercel-forwarded-for, else x-real-ip, else x-forwarded-for. Vercel overwrites X-Forwarded-For to prevent spoofing (https://vercel.com/docs/headers/request-headers). Missing header -> one shared "unknown" bucket.
limits.hardBounds: Per request: at most 4 Jev calls and 8,000 input tokens, i.e. <= $0.000336 at the dated price. Per instance: <= 60 runs/hour and 300/day, i.e. <= $0.0202/hour and <= $0.101/day. Counters are in memory per instance, so the cross-instance total is not durable; the kill switch is the global stop.

evidence.hashScope: sha256 of JSON.stringify(replayCore): input, enclosed cohort, frozen policy, seeds, every round request and raw Jev answer, outcome, check, provenance. Excludes runId, createdAt, cached, latency and economics. Unsigned.
evidence.replay: Recompute seeds from word overlap. For each round re-apply readScore/readEnough/readView and frozenPolicy to rawAnswers to recompute kept notes, next frontier and stop reason. Recompute cost from jevInputTokens and pricingSnapshot.
